causes.cause: A KPI card's gap is 12px in ours, 10px in the preview. kpiStyles.ts sets .openui-dashboard-kpi { gap: 10px }, but styles.ts's .openui-dashboard-card { gap: var(--openui-dashboard-space-sm) } has the same specificity and is inserted later, so it wins (the preview inserts .pdk-kpi after .pdk-card). Each KPI card is 4px taller, which moves its value, foot and visual down 2-4px and every unit below the strip by 4px per row.
